newsitem.title: POLAND: Universal gets U.S. permit for ADR issue.
newsitem.headline: Universal gets U.S. permit for ADR issue.

text.p: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission has granted Polish trader Universal SA the first of the two required permits for a planned issue of American Depositary Receipts (ADRs), the firm said in a statement.
The Polish Securities Commission earlier approved Universal's ADRs issue, to be carried out by the Bank of America, which could amount to up to 9.78 percent of the firm's shares in public trade.
The shares to be sold as ADRs would be taken from those currently on the Warsaw bourse, which means the number of shares listed domestically would fall.
Universal's ADRs issue would be the fourth by a Polish company, following listings by Mostostal Export, Stalexport and Bank Gdanski.
